<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="c90a2b444a3623120064ed56263be407" table="catalog_script_client"><catalog_script_client action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><applies_catalog>true</applies_catalog><applies_extended>false</applies_extended><applies_req_item>true</applies_req_item><applies_sc_task>true</applies_sc_task><applies_target_record>false</applies_target_record><applies_to>item</applies_to><cat_item display_value="GitHub Enterprise and Copilot Service Request">6212b17c1b42d4108dbf42eddc4bcbd3</cat_item><cat_variable>IO:9f3344b81b0ff2d04877dc68b04bcb1c</cat_variable><condition/><description/><field/><global>true</global><isolate_script>true</isolate_script><messages/><name>Field visibility SecretsVariable Request</name><order/><published_ref/><script><![CDATA[function onChange(control, oldValue, newValue, isLoading) {
   if (isLoading || newValue == '') {
      return;
   }

   //Type appropriate comment here, and begin script below
   var type=g_form.getValue('request_type');

   if(type=='repository_variable'||type=='environment_variables')
   {
	g_form.setMandatory('project_space_url',true);
	g_form.setDisplay('project_space_url', true);
	
	g_form.setMandatory('organization_name',false);
	g_form.setDisplay('organization_name', false);
	
   }
   else if(type=='organisation_variables')
   {
	g_form.setMandatory('project_space_url',false);
	g_form.setDisplay('project_space_url', false);
	
	g_form.setMandatory('organization_name',true);
	g_form.setDisplay('organization_name', true);
   }
}]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>Radha.Gopalappa</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-02-13 04:49:09</sys_created_on><sys_customer_update>false</sys_customer_update><sys_domain>c90a2b444a3623120064ed56263be407</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>!!!/!!#/!!!/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>1f8b9e951b4ffad04877dc68b04bcb45</sys_id><sys_mod_count>6</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Field visibility SecretsVariable Request</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_replace_on_upgrade>false</sys_replace_on_upgrade><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_1f8b9e951b4ffad04877dc68b04bcb45</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>Radha.Gopalappa</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-02-17 05:20:49</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onChange</type><ui_type>10</ui_type><va_supported>true</va_supported><variable_set/><view/></catalog_script_client></record_update>

    variablesToClear.forEach(function(variable) {
        g_form.clearValue(variable);
    });
}

false6212b17c1b42d4108dbf42eddc4bcbd3downfalsefalsefalsefalsefalseDisclaimerfalsefalseYou are using the Github sites on your own accord. Use of this service is limited only to non-sensitive and publicly available data. Users must not use, share, or store any kind of sensitive data such as Personally Identifiable Information (PII) and/or Protected Health Information (PHI), etc. under any circumstance. Users shall not store their username and password details in GitHub. Any source code uploaded to GitHub will be considered the Intellectual property of UST Global and cannot be shared elsewhere.

 

Administrators for this service reserve the right to moderate all information used, shared, or stored with this service at any time. Any user that cannot abide by this disclaimer and Code of Conduct may be subject to action, up to and including revoking access to services.

 

This site is not monitored by UST IT Infra team.

UST Global Management  is not responsible for any  breach of Customer Policy by use of Github services.

Users should not use  personal Github account to store UST / Customer’s code. It is a violation of Intellectual property.

User should not upload Customer and UST's proprietary  software codes in github without the explicit approval by the Account Management / PMO members.

 

Any Violation of the above will be Considered as a breach of UST and Customer policy and UST's Security Incident Management process would follow. The implications can be as high as termination, as per the UST HR policy.

 

GITHUB – BEST SECURITY PRACTICES

REVIEW SOURCE CODE BEFORE IMPORTING 

Before importing a project into a public GitHub repo, fully audit the history for sensitive data, and remove it before adding to GitHub. 

 

SENSITIVE DATA

Never store credentials as code/config in GitHub 

  • Block sensitive data being pushed to GitHub by git-secrets or its likes as a git pre-commit hook. 
  • Audit for slipped secrets with GitRob or truffleHog. 
  • Use ENV variables for secrets in CI/CD and secret managers like Vault in production 

 

REMOVING SENSITIVE DATA

  • Invalidate tokens and passwords 
  • Remove the info and clear the GitHub history (force push rewrite history). 

 

ROTATE YOUR CREDENTIAL

To prevent leaked credentials, periodically refresh SSH Keys, Personal Token and Password.

TIGHTLY CONTROL ACCESS

  • Require Two-factor authentication for all your GitHub accounts. 
  • Never share GitHub accounts/passwords. 
  • Any laptops/devices with access to your source code must be properly secured. 
  • Revoke access from users who are no longer working in the project. 
  • Manage team access to data. Give contributors only access to what they need to do their work. 

 

ADDITIONAL  SECURITY GUIDELINES

  • Disclosure policy

Define the procedure for what a reporter who finds a security issue needs to do in order to fully disclose the problem safely, including who to contact and how. Refer to our Information Security Policy.

  • Security Update policy 

Define how you intend to update users about new security vulnerabilities as they are found. Refer to our Personnel Security Policy and  Acceptable Use Policy.

  • Security related configuration 

Settings users should consider that would impact the security posture of deploying this project, such as HTTPS, authorization and many others. 

 

Important Note: Always ensure to get Customer / UST’s AM consent before uploading project code into the GITHUB

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="c90a2b444a3623120064ed56263be407" table="catalog_script_client"><catalog_script_client action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><applies_catalog>true</applies_catalog><applies_extended>false</applies_extended><applies_req_item>true</applies_req_item><applies_sc_task>true</applies_sc_task><applies_target_record>false</applies_target_record><applies_to>item</applies_to><cat_item display_value="GitHub Enterprise and Copilot Service Request">6212b17c1b42d4108dbf42eddc4bcbd3</cat_item><cat_variable>IO:18dad2c31bf672904877dc68b04bcb91</cat_variable><condition/><description/><field/><global>true</global><isolate_script>true</isolate_script><messages/><name>Expiry date cannot be more than a year</name><order/><published_ref/><script><![CDATA[function onChange(control, oldValue, newValue, isLoading) {
   if (isLoading || newValue == '') {
      return;
   }

   //Type appropriate comment here, and begin script below
    var expiry_date = g_form.getValue('expiry_date');
if (!expiry_date) {
    return;
}

var today = new Date();

var oneYearFromToday = new Date(
    today.getFullYear(),
    today.getMonth() + 12,
    today.getDate()
);

var selectedDate = new Date(expiry_date);

if (selectedDate > oneYearFromToday) {
    g_form.setValue('expiry_date', '');

	g_form.setMandatory('project_space_url',true);

	g_form.setMandatory('organization_name',false);

	g_form.setMandatory('organization_name',true);
	g_form.setDisplay('organization_name', true);
   }
   
}]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>Radha.Gopalappa</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-02-17 05:17:42</sys_created_on><sys_customer_update>false</sys_customer_update><sys_domain>c90a2b444a3623120064ed56263be407</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>!!!/!!#/!!!/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>2df9cf221bc3fa10b01453de034bcbef</sys_id><sys_mod_count>2</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Secretvariable onload</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_replace_on_upgrade>false</sys_replace_on_upgrade><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_2df9cf221bc3fa10b01453de034bcbef</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>Radha.Gopalappa</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-02-17 05:21:00</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onLoad</type><ui_type>10</ui_type><va_supported>true</va_supported><variable_set/><view/></catalog_script_client></record_update>
